triggerReason: Human control still ended at an administrator approval and did not make stakeholder definitions, minority impacts, dissent, correction, appeal, or public explanation part of the verifiable loop.
action: Added versioned synthetic stakeholder groups, deterministic group-impact simulation, authenticated goal deliberation, SLA-bound feedback and appeals with real cross-domain effects, structured decision/incident/outcome explanations, a seven-attack governance red-team gate, durable memory/PostgreSQL APIs, and an accessible bilingual Participation Center.
outcome: NEXUS-7 now prevents average improvement from hiding severe group harm, requires separately authenticated human approvals for agent-raised objective weights, lets successful appeals reopen incidents, invalidate lessons/playbooks, or request evidence, and exposes reconstructible public evidence without claiming to represent real populations.

metrics.label: Appeal effects applied to owning services

evidence: Stakeholder definitions, weights, thresholds, effective times, and supersession are versioned synthetic records
Deterministic impact simulation reads the governed city snapshot and every active group
Severe protected-group harm blocks approval even when a population-weighted average improves
Every HTTP approval is bound to its authenticated human identity; two-person approval requires two separate actors
Service accounts cannot decide or apply deliberations and minority opinions remain inspectable
Feedback records owner, per-kind SLA, response, appeal, resolution, and append-only transition events
Overturned appeals actually invoke City, Outcome Learning, or Planning and require target-kind and target-ID equality
Decision, incident, and outcome explanations rebuild from structured facts and reject fingerprint tampering
All seven fixed governance attacks are contained by the real service acceptance suite
Memory/PostgreSQL, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, production build, browser workflow, mobile layout, and axe gates cover the vertical slice
